description: Terabyte scale dataset for partial discharge detection in covered conductors via contact galvanic method is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Michal Krátký et al. This article introduces a dataset designed for the detection of partial discharges in transmission power lines using covered conductors through a contact galvanic method, sourced from real environments across 23 different power lines in various locations. Though partially introduced in a Kaggle competition (only 3% of data), its full extent is disclosed here for the first time. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, ZIP. The data are held in Harvard Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 192679390. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
